name: Crude Oil
comment: A naturally occurring mixture of hydrocarbons extracted from underground reservoirs. It is the main feedstock for producing fuels and petrochemical products

name: Gasoil
comment: A middle distillate used to produce diesel fuel, heating oil, and other industrial products.

name: Gasoline
comment: A light fuel used in spark ignition engines, such as those in most passenger cars.

name: Naphtha
comment: A light petroleum fraction used as feedstock for petrochemicals and as a component in gasoline production.

name: Jet Fuel
comment: A kerosene-based fuel used in aircraft gas turbine engines.

name: Fuel Oil
comment: A heavy liquid fuel used in marine engines, boilers, and industrial equipment.

name: Vacuum Gasoil
comment: A heavy petroleum fraction produced by vacuum distillation. It is used as feedstock for catalytic cracking and other refining processes.

name: Bitumen
comment: A thick or solid petroleum material commonly used in road construction and waterproofing.

name: LPG
comment: Liquefied petroleum gas, usually a mixture of propane and butane. It is used as fuel and as a petrochemical feedstock.

name: Kerosene
comment: A petroleum fraction between gasoline and gasoil, used for heating, lighting, and as a component of aviation fuel.

name: Base Oils
comment: The primary oils used to manufacture lubricants. Additives are blended in to achieve specific performance properties.

name: Marine Fuels
comment: Fuels used by ships, including residual and distillate grades selected to meet engine requirements and emissions regulations.

name: Gas Condensate
comment: A liquid hydrocarbon mixture separated from natural gas during production and processing. It is used as a fuel component and petrochemical feedstock.

name: Petroleum Coke
comment: A solid, carbon-rich product made from heavy petroleum residues. It is used in industrial processes and energy production.
